subject: Urgent: FieldDay Expo — booth power outage and speaker backup plan
messages:
From: Nicole Ramos <nicole@eventops.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: LiveCity AV <av@livecity.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: FieldDay Expo — Day 1 site update

Hi Laura / Evelyn —

Quick heads-up from the floor: at 07:50 we saw visible arcing behind bay D (near Row 4), which tripped one of the breakers serving several booth circuits. The exhibitor booth for Acme had their badge scanners go dark and a couple of power strips showed smoke (no injuries). We pulled the breakers and put up warning tape.

LiveCity AV is on-site and has started diagnostics; they said one panel might need a temporary bypass while they source a replacement breaker. Badge re-registration kiosks are down; attendees are queueing. Acme’s onsite events contact (events@acmesoft.com) just messaged that their product demo is due at 09:00.

I attached a quick phone photo of the panel and a short scanner error log.

Can the Redwood team confirm whether we should move the Acme demo or cover it with a backup presenter? Also, can we get confirmation on whether the power issue affects our demo stage audio/AV?

—Nicole
Event Operations / FieldDay Logistics
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Thanks for the quick report, Nicole.

Evelyn / LiveCity: please prioritize the demo stage (Stage B) and the Acme booth circuit. Marcus — heads up that Acme is scheduled at 09:00; if the circuit can't be restored before then we need a contingency. Options I want on the table within the next 10 minutes:
- temporary generator or on-site UPS to keep badge scanners online
- move Acme demo to Breakout Room 2 (confirmed 09:00 slot) — requires AV patch and mic
- have Marcus or another Redwood rep run a 15-minute fireside-style product Q&A if Acme needs time to set up

Also confirm if any of our signage or demo equipment is affected (charging stations, demo laptops). Nicole — estimate for breaker bypass or replacement? LiveCity: ETA for a tech and for a generator (if available).

I’m heading to the floor now. Keep replies short — we need clear decisions.

—Laura Bennett

Laura / team —

On-site update from LiveCity tech lead (Eddie):
- Cause: loose lug on panel A12 caused arcing; breaker tripped as designed.
- Immediate fix: we can do a temporary bypass on the affected leg and swap the lug now. Estimated time to restore affected booths (including Acme): ~25–35 minutes.
- Generator: we have a portable generator (5kW) and two UPS packs that can keep badge kiosks and demo laptops alive for the next 2 hours. We will need a crew member to assist with lug replacement and to run power tails to the booths.
- AV for Stage B is on a separate panel and not affected, but the house PA mains are on the same distribution board as some exhibitor circuits — we recommend keeping Stage B on mains to preserve audio quality and only move a single demo host to Breakout Room 2 if the Acme demo needs to shift.

Attachments: we captured photo of the lug/arcing point and the scanner log you sent (included in this thread).

Eddie
LiveCity AV — Field Operations
av@livecity.com | +1 415-555-0133

I can jump on Stage B for a 10–15 minute product overview and then transition to a Q&A if they arrive late — I have the slide deck and can run the demo portion at high level (no live environment). If LiveCity can get a UPS on their badge kiosks, that will keep registration running and buy us time. If not, we should set up a manual check-in table with a staffer and paper badges (I can lead that if needed).

Subject: Action plan: FieldDay Expo — power & speaker contingency (final)

Team — finalizing plan after site check:

1) Power & badge scanners
- LiveCity will perform the lug swap and temporary bypass now; ETA to restore affected booths: 25–35 minutes (target 09:05–09:15).
- We are deploying two UPS packs to Acme booth and the main registration kiosk immediately.
- Marcus and Tessa: stand by at Kiosk East for manual check-in fallback (paper badges). Marcus to take lead if UPS fails.

2) Acme demo / speaker contingency
- Acme presenter delayed ~45 mins. Nora Blake (speaker hub) is on standby and can deliver a 20-minute replacement talk on "Scaling Inference at Low Latency" at 09:00 on Stage B if we need it. Nora confirmed via phone and can arrive in 10 minutes. Marcus will host a Q&A for 10–15 mins post-talk.
- If we keep Acme in their slot, LiveCity: priority is to get their booth powered by 09:15 so they can run the demo at 09:30.

3) Comms & signage
- Nicole: please put a notice at the registration desk that some demos are delayed due to technical work; state ETA (approx. 09:15).
- Tessa: push a short in-app announcement (FieldDay app) with the updated schedule and stage notes.

4) Safety & vendor billing
- LiveCity: please confirm if any permanent equipment damage occurred (site photos indicate charring) and flag for incident billing. We will collect receipts for any generator rental/urgent parts and route to Finance.

5) Follow-ups
- I’ve uploaded the quick incident MOP to our shared drive (link: https://drive.redwood.com/fieldday/mops/2026-06-12-incident — internal). Please use that for checklist items.

Thanks everyone for the fast responses. Laura, Marcus — I’ll stay on the floor and coordinate until the situation is resolved. Update incoming when Acme is either on-stage or we swap to Nora.

—Evelyn Hart
Events Program Manager — Redwood Inference
